dedupe_keys.name: fsri residential hvac gas burner experiments

description: UL Fire Safety Research Institute publishes measurements and supporting files from 29 propane gas-burner experiments in a ranch-style house with a basement and an HVAC system. The experiments vary HVAC operation, fire location and heat release rate, and bedroom-door position to study heat and combustion-gas transport. The GitHub README identifies sequential CSV measurement files, timestamped event files, channel lists and instrumented floor-plan documentation. Python plotting scripts produce graphs from these files. Data belong to one experimental structure; the root documentation does not establish the sampling interval. Public access is free and the repository declares the MIT licence. Its licence text addresses software and associated documentation; the review does not establish a separate data-specific licence. The README calls the building single-storey with a basement, while the article calls it two-storey. These appear to describe the same experimental structure, but the wording difference is retained. A reviewer-assessed use is validating ventilation and smoke-transport calculations with model-nist-fds-smokeview. No data were downloaded and no fire simulation was executed.
